osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried skewers, including a mentaiko-mayo bread skewer and mini buns (October 2026), with sauces, ponzu, sesame mustard and salt.
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The omakase mixes vegetable skewers (asparagus, taro, shiitake, tomato) with shrimp, crab, beef and eel; the shop asks about dislikes and allergies before the course (Tabelog; October 2026), but nothing is said about the batter or frying oil.
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00; closed Mondays; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: full at 17:00 on an October 2026 Sunday. Vegetable charge ¥330 per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 28 seats: a 12-seat counter on the 1st floor (smoking allowed), tables for 10 on the 2nd floor (non-smoking) and a private room for 3–5 (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_kenkushi_shimanouchi.notes: [Kushiage · Shimanouchi, creative skewers until you say stop] A chic, dark-toned kushiage counter near Nagahoribashi where the omakase brings seasonal and playful skewers — mapo tofu in an edible basket, penguin-shaped bread, eel with ginger — alongside classics like angel shrimp and beef fillet, until you call stop. Staff suggest a sauce for each skewer and ask about dislikes and allergies first. Expect about 15 skewers and ¥4,000–7,000 a head. Book: it is full at opening at weekends. Smoking is allowed at the ground-floor counter; the upstairs tables are non-smoking.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 4 February 2020, later reopened after a renewal; creative kushiage using techniques honed at a long-established restaurant. Per tabiiro: the owner trained at well-known Osaka restaurants and fries in front of guests; a second shop opened in Umeda Nakazakicho in May 2024.

anecdotes.text: "I was surprised by the innovative idea of the mapo tofu skewer, where even the basket it came in was edible!" — October 2026, a 15-skewer course.
"The hospitality is exceptional" — August 2026, a reviewer noting that dislikes and allergies are carefully accommodated.
"While the flavors were delicious, I felt that the overall dishes could have used a bit less oil." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げ専門店 健串、串揚げ・居酒屋・魚介、大阪市中央区島之内1-12-17、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝17:00〜24:00、月曜休み、不定休、予約可、野菜代330円、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、28席 (1階カウンター12席は喫煙可、2階テーブル10席は禁煙、個室3〜5名)、子ども可、2020年2月4日オープン。老舗で磨いた技の創作串揚げ、旬の素材のおまかせをストップまで、1本110〜570円、ソムリエのワインと日本酒の専門家が選ぶ日本酒、苦手なものやアレルギーは事前に。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 野菜スティック、アスパラ、牛ヒレ、明太マヨのパン、自家製麻婆豆腐、納豆、エビのすり身のしいたけ、里芋、うなぎと生姜、カジキ、トマトとモッツァレラ、Angel shrimp、カニ、ペンギンの形のパン、ソース3種と塩、ポン酢、ごまからし、15〜18本と飲み物でひとり7,000円ほど、日曜17時に満席、油がもう少し少なくてもという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase until you say stop; staff recommend a sauce for each skewer and ask about dislikes and allergies (2026). An October 2026 reviewer calls it popular with foreigners. No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Asks about dislikes and allergies before the omakase (Tabelog shop text; reviews August and October 2026).

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options but no detail. The steamed-vegetable sets come with salt ponzu, koji-yuzu mayo and bonito salt sauces (August 2026); udon, tempura and fries are also on the menu.
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options but no detail. The 12-vegetable steamer set came with bonito flakes and a bit of hamo (September 2026), and the dipping sauces include bonito salt, so ask for it without.
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.hours_raw: Tabelog gives daily 11:30–23:30 and, in its notes, Mon–Fri and Sat/holidays 11:30–23:00; open year-round. Lunch sets were still served after 16:00 on an August 2026 day. Reservations accepted, but not for café use; phone may be hard to reach at lunch (Tabelog). Menu and ordering, and payment, by smartphone (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR payment; no cover charge (Tabelog). 60 seats: low sofas, a 10-seat counter, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace with kotatsu in winter (Tabelog; 2024–2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). The entrance is easy to miss; staff let you in (2026).
osaka_sorairo_color_hakuromachi.notes: [Japanese dining bar · Hakuromachi, steamed-vegetable lunches on sofas] A greenery-filled dining bar a few minutes west of Midosuji, with low sofas, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace (kotatsu in winter). At lunch, order a bamboo steamer of a dozen vegetables or pork with three homemade sauces for about ¥1,300–1,700; at night, sashimi, hamo tempura and mentaiko udon with seasonal sake. Order and pay on your phone. Reviews in 2026 also mention dated cleanliness and an over-hot terrace in September.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member) and website sorairocolor.jp: a Japanese dining bar and café with seafood delivered daily, sake from around Japan and desserts made by a pastry chef.

anecdotes.text: "The entrance is a bit tricky, and you need to be noticed by the staff inside to get in." — September 2026, a fourth visit.
"The staff explained, 'You can enjoy the broth as a clear soup or pour it over rice like hitsumabushi'" — October 2026, the seafood yukke set.
"The cleanliness remains an issue, and the staff's friendliness was lacking as usual." — September 2026, a repeat visitor who otherwise liked the food.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 空色COLOR、ダイニングバー・魚介・カフェ、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-1、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:30〜23:30 (詳細では月〜金・土祝11:30〜23:00)、年中無休、予約可 (カフェ利用は不可)、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、チャージ料なし、60席 (ソファ、カウンター10席、座敷)、禁煙、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの対応ありと表示、公式 sorairocolor.jp。毎日直送の魚、刺身の盛り合わせ、季節の日本酒、パティシエの手作りデザート、かき氷、冬の鍋コース3,000円・3,500円・4,000円 (飲み放題+2,000円)。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 野菜12種のせいろの御膳1,280円、ブランド豚と野菜のせいろ1,680円、かつお塩・麹柚子マヨ・塩ポン酢のたれ、焼き魚の定食、海鮮ユッケの定食、白米か雑穀米、大盛り無料、スマホで注文と支払い、入口がわかりにくい、ハモの天ぷら、明太うどん、清潔さが気になるという声、テラスが暑かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu, ordering and payment on your smartphone (2026); sofa and tatami seating. No English evidence found.

osaka_avocado_house_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Tacos and fajitas come with tortillas (type not stated); the menu also has fish and chips, onion rings, nachos, quesadillas and enchiladas.
osaka_avocado_house_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Plain avocado, avocado tacos, salsa and chips and guacamole are on the menu (September–October 2026), but nothing is described as vegan; many dishes use cheese, meat or fish.
osaka_avocado_house_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00; Sat–Sun 15:00–24:00; closed 1 January and irregularly (Tabelog). Other listings give different hours (search results, 2026-11-02), so check. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Mobile ordering (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and au PAY (Tabelog). 52 seats including an 8-seat counter; non-smoking, smoking area outside after 22:00; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, but late-night visits with children may be refused (Tabelog).
osaka_avocado_house_namba.notes: [Mexican · Namba, avocado everything] A pink-fronted, mural-covered Mexican bar two minutes from Namba Station, where rich avocados go into almost every dish. Order the plain premium avocado (¥913), guacamole, a few tacos (¥495–605) and the chicken fajitas, flamed with tequila at the table; heat is mild, with six habanero sauces to add. The ¥4,000–5,000 courses bring three hours of drinks and unlimited tacos. Lively, with many international guests (September 2026); opens 15:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 5 November 2021; avocados chosen by oil content; "authentic cuisine that satisfies Mexicans".

anecdotes.text: "There were many international guests, and the lively ambiance made it feel like I was abroad!" — September 2026.
"The Chicken Fajitas ... are served sizzling on a teppan with spiced chicken and vegetables, flambéed with tequila right in front of you" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): AVOCADO HOUSE NAMBA、メキシコ料理・バル・カフェ、大阪市中央区難波3-3-4 難波日大ビル 1F、なんば駅19番出口から約2分、月〜金17:00〜24:00、土日15:00〜24:00、不定休と1月1日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、52席 (カウンター8)、禁煙 (22時以降は店外に喫煙所)、深夜は子ども連れを断る場合あり、2021年11月5日オープン。油分で選んだ「Premium Rich Avocado」、炎の上がるチキンファヒータ、フルーツカクテル、3時間飲み放題とタコス食べ放題のコース4,000〜5,000円。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): アボカド913円、アボカドのチーズグラタン1,298円、シーザーサラダ1,628円、チキンファヒータ2,420円、タコス495〜605円、チリコンカン968円、ハバネロソース6種、辛さは控えめ、外国人客が多くにぎやか、モバイルオーダー。

cultural_comfort.note: Many international guests (September 2026); mobile ordering. No English-menu evidence found.

osaka_nikudokoro_kisshan_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku comes with sauces, the lunch hamburger with a Japanese-style sauce (September 2026), and the sukiyaki course ends with udon (September 2026).
osaka_nikudokoro_kisshan_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kuroge wagyu yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu restaurant.
osaka_nikudokoro_kisshan_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–23:00; Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed only when Takashimaya closes (Tabelog). An August 2025 reviewer was told the regular menu now runs on after lunch without a break. Reservations accepted; private rooms need booking (Tabelog); the Takumi course is for two or more (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), iD, QUICPay and QR payment (Tabelog). 51 seats at tables, private rooms for 2 to 24; non-smoking; smoke-free roasters; wheelchair access; children welcome (Tabelog). Takashimaya parking free for 2 hours with ¥3,000 spent (Tabelog).
osaka_nikudokoro_kisshan_namba.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, butcher-run wagyu in Takashimaya] A wagyu yakiniku restaurant on the 8th-floor dining floor of Takashimaya at Namba, from a butcher-backed group (founded 1995). The lunch sets are the value: 150 g of kuroge wagyu and skirt with rice, soup and salad, or a cold-noodle and bibimbap half-and-half at ¥1,680. Dinner courses run ¥5,800–7,200; private rooms are popular and must be booked. Reviews in 2026 split between attentive service and a sukiyaki course where a nearly full room outran the staff (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): founded in 1995, backed by a butcher shop in Osaka for 50 years; this shop opened 2 March 2010. Per gurunavi, the group's main shop is 西中島総本店; a Tennoji shop is mentioned on Retty and by a September 2026 reviewer.

anecdotes.text: "... a basket to place my belongings in, and after I put my bag inside ... a cloth to cover it." — September 2026, Saturday noon, alone.
"I waited about 20 minutes without anything arriving. The hot pot was burning" — September 2026, the domestic beef sukiyaki course in a nearly full room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛焼肉 肉處 きっしゃん なんば店、焼肉・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、大阪市中央区難波5-1-18 なんばダイニングメゾン 8F (高島屋)、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、月〜金11:00〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)、17:00〜23:00、土日11:00〜15:00、17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、高島屋の休館日に準ずる、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、51席 (テーブル)、個室2〜24名、禁煙、無煙ロースター、子ども可、2010年3月2日オープン。1995年創業、大阪で50年の精肉店が母体、全国のA5の黒毛和牛 (おもに雌)、きっしゃんコース5,800円、Takumi のコース7,200円、ランチの和牛100%ハンバーグと焼肉ランチ。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 黒毛和牛とハラミの150gのランチ、冷麺と石焼ビビンバのハーフ&ハーフ1,680円、ホルモンと赤身のランチ、塩タン、カルビ、ハラミ、maruchou、荷物のかごと布、満席ですき焼きのコースの対応が遅かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store dining floor with set lunches and courses; private rooms. No English evidence found.

osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat gyoza skins, xiaolongbao and dumplings throughout, with soy-based dipping sauce.
osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the gyoza filling is domestic black pork (Tabelog); braised pork, chicken and shrimp dumplings.
osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–1:00; Sun 17:00–23:00; closures not fixed; open over New Year (Tabelog). A July 2024 diner listed weekday hours from 11:30 with lunch to 15:00; the current listing gives evenings only. Reservations accepted by phone (Tabelog). No cards, e-money or QR payment (Tabelog); "payment is cash only" (October 2024). 18 seats, a counter at the front and tables behind, private rooms, private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2025). A small appetiser is served on sitting down: tofu with chive chili oil (May 2025), potato salad (August 2026).
osaka_gyoza_kobo_gyoiiin_nishinakajima.notes: [Gyoza · Minamikata, bite-sized gyoza and a drink until 1:00] An 18-seat gyoza bar three minutes from Hankyu Minamikata, with a counter at the front and tables behind, where the gyoza are small enough to eat in one bite. Six pan-fried or boiled cost ¥430 (2026); a regular rates the light boiled ones best and the chilled gyoza as something new, and the table garlic oil is the house tip. Mapo tofu, braised pork and xiaolongbao round it out with beer and tea-shochu highballs. On several visits one person ran the whole place (2025–2026), and it suits a quick drink or a second stop after dinner. Open from 17:00 to 1:00 (Sundays to 23:00); cash only; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner-operator (unnamed); a regular calls the person running the shop "Yassan"
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a gyoza specialist with Chinese dishes and a drinks list; gyoza of domestic black pork and vegetables in thin skins sized for one bite; recommended to try them plain, then with garlic oil in the dipping sauce; two banquet courses with all-you-can-drink. Per reviews: "It was just Yassan running the place alone" (March 2026; also May 2025); "Even though it was a one-person operation, the service was surprisingly good" (August 2026); when a diner spilt chili oil on a white T-shirt, "the owner kindly handed me a towel with bleach on it" (May 2025); several diners found it quiet or empty early in the evening (2025–2026); a long-time regular counts 15 visits (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Bite-sized boiled and pan-fried gyoza with garlic oil; chilled gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "When you come to Gyoiiiiiin, you must start with the water dumplings!" — a regular on the 15th visit, March 2026.
"This dish breaks the concept that dumplings should be served hot." — May 2025, on the chilled gyoza.
"We dipped the gyoza in garlic oil and scooped some garlic with the folds for a bite. The flavor and aroma exploded." — June 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 餃子工房 ギョィィィィィィン、餃子・中華料理・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島3-15-17、Hankyu Minamikata 駅か Midosuji Line の西中島南方駅から徒歩3分、月〜土・祝17:00〜翌1:00、日17:00〜23:00、定休日は不定、年末年始も営業、電話で予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、18席、個室あり、20名まで貸切可、喫煙可、国産の黒豚と野菜の一口餃子、焼き餃子と水餃子6個430円、チーズや麻辣、冷やし餃子、にんにくオイル、宴会コース2種 (飲み放題つき)。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年8月): 麻辣餃子、エビ餃子、中華角煮680円、小籠包2個500円、冷やし餃子6個500円、mapo tofu、yodare-dori、おつまみ3種盛り (キムチ、ナムルなど)、塩だれキャベツ、生ビール550円、お茶割りの焼酎500円、シャーベットのレモンサワー、ひとりで切り盛りしていた日も、遅くまで開いていて2軒目に、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats for solo diners (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles (Hokkaido flour, Tabelog) in miso or shoyu broth; winged gyoza.
osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broth of chicken bones and niboshi (June 2026), lard, thick pork chashu.
osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00, until sold out; closures not fixed (Tabelog). Tsukemen is served in the evening only, per a regular (April 2026). No reservations; no cards (Tabelog); cash only, per a February 2026 diner. 27 seats: 8 at the counter and 14 at tables; non-smoking; parking for 3 cars; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). A diner was told the building is temporary and the air conditioning could go no lower (July 2026).
osaka_ramen_jin_ihara_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Sapporo-style grilled miso tossed over open flame] A 27-seat miso ramen specialist a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where flames leap from the pot as the chef tosses vegetables and lard before the miso goes in (2026). The Sapporo-style grilled miso (¥1,100) comes piping hot, richer-looking than it tastes, with homemade Hokkaido-flour noodles and thick chashu; regulars swear by the grilled shoyu with extra vegetables. Winter brings a black-garlic and cheese miso, November a Hiroshima lemon shoyu. The walls are covered in Orix baseball signatures and photos. Cash only; parking for three cars; tsukemen in the evening only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "The only Miso Ramen Specialty Shop in the ramen battleground of Nishinakajima"; celebrating its 10th anniversary; "The founder, who has thoroughly researched miso from all over Japan, has perfected the ultimate soup by adding unique twists to Hokkaido miso"; homemade noodles of Hokkaido flour blended with "Haru yo Koi". Per reviews: a diner says it "has been operating in this location for over 20 years" (April 2026) and another returned "after more than 10 years" (May 2026); signed memorabilia and photos of Orix players, especially Ryoma Nishikawa, cover the walls (2026); a regular on the 16th visit chats with the owner and staff (2025–2026); one diner could not hear the staff and had to ask three times which bowl was which (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Miso from all over Japan researched to make "the ultimate soup" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sapporo-style grilled miso ramen; grilled shoyu with vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "As I watched the flames rise higher than the chef’s face, I worried my fine hairs might get singed." — August 2026.
"It has a rich, roasted flavor and depth, yet surprisingly leaves a light aftertaste that is distinct from its appearance." — August 2026, Sapporo-style grilled miso ¥1,100.
"It seems like the oil is adjusted according to the season, and for summer, it’s a bit lighter." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): らぁめん じん IHARA店 (西中島店)、つけ麺・ラーメン・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島2-14-34、Midosuji Line の西中島南方駅南口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜14:00、18:00〜23:00、売り切れまで、定休日は不定、予約不可、カード不可、27席 (カウンター8、テーブル14)、禁煙、駐車場3台、子ども歓迎、テイクアウト、西中島で唯一の味噌ラーメン専門店、10周年、北海道の小麦粉 Haru yo Koi をブレンドした自家製麺。口コミ (2024年〜2026年9月): 炙り味噌ラーメン、Sapporo 式の炙り味噌1,100円、Miso Revenge 1,200円、Orix の Ryoma Nishikawa おすすめのスペシャル1,200円、Aburi Shoyu の野菜増し、Hiroshima lemon shoyu ラーメン、黒にんにくオイルとチーズの味噌 (冬)、鶏ガラと煮干しのスープ、中太の麺、厚切りのチャーシュー、ハラミ丼のセット1,500円、羽根つきの gyoza、つけ麺は夜だけ、現金のみ、仮設の建物でエアコンが弱いという声も。

osaka_ryusho_higashiyodogawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles (whole wheat, 2026); kara-age and gyoza on the side.
osaka_ryusho_higashiyodogawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broth of pork bones, trotters, chicken bones and feet, niboshi and katsuobushi (Tabelog); chashu in the dip.
osaka_ryusho_higashiyodogawa.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–2:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards (Tabelog); tickets from a cash vending machine inside the entrance (May 2026, October 2026); PayPay accepted (February 2026). 16 seats, counter and tables; smoking in a designated area at night only; coin parking nearby (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2014 (Tabelog). Busy at weekday lunch, quieter at weekends (October 2026).
osaka_ryusho_higashiyodogawa.notes: [Ramen · JR Higashi-Yodogawa, seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen until 2 a.m.] A 16-seat tsukemen shop a minute from JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2014 and one of the few places to eat round the station until 2 a.m. The dip is a thick seafood-and-pork-bone broth made without back fat, full of diced chashu and sautéed onion, for thick, firm whole-wheat noodles; squeeze in the lemon halfway, and finish with soup to dilute the dip. Pork tsukemen is ¥1,000; the sweet and spicy tsukemen in four heat levels is the favourite (2026). Tickets from a cash machine at the door; PayPay too. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 1 August 2014; "Rich Seafood and Pork Bone Broth"; over a dozen ingredients simmered for more than 15 hours; "We do not use any artificial seasonings. To prioritize your health, we avoid using back fat"; soy sauce, salt, dipping soba and tsukemen. Per reviews: "They boil 80 kilograms of tonkotsu every day" (a diner, March 2026); "The staff were friendly and busy, providing thoughtful advice on menu selections" (July 2026); a discount for regular customers posted inside (October 2026); one May 2026 diner found the room greasy and saw flies.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Don’t leave any noodles behind; be sure to drink the broth!" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen; sweet and spicy tsukemen.

anecdotes.text: "Although it’s described as a rich seafood and pork bone broth, it wasn’t heavy due to the absence of back fat." — February 2026, pork tsukemen ¥1,000.
"The rich dipping sauce sticks to your lips when you wipe your mouth with a tissue! That’s how thick the dipping sauce is!" — March 2026, special tsukemen ¥1,400.
"The area around Higashiyodogawa Station doesn’t have many dining options … so a place that stays open late is quite valuable." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 隆勝、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区東三国1-1-32、JR 東淀川駅から1分、月・火・木〜日11:00〜14:30、17:30〜翌2:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、16席、夜のみ喫煙所で喫煙可、近くにコインパーキング、2014年8月1日オープン、濃厚魚介豚骨、豚骨 (髄の骨と背骨)、豚足、鶏ガラ、鶏の足、煮干し、かつお節、しいたけ、昆布、野菜など十数種を15時間以上、化学調味料なし、背脂なし。口コミ (2024年〜2026年10月): 店内の券売機 (現金)、PayPay 可、豚のつけ麺1,000円、大盛り180円、chicken paitan のつけ麺980円、別皿つきのつけ麺1,400円、Sweet and Spicy のつけ麺は辛さ4段階、まぜそば、全粒粉の太いストレート麺、つけだれに角切りチャーシューと玉ねぎ、途中でレモン、最後にスープ割り、kara-age、gyoza、チャーハン、夜遅くまで開いている。

osaka_takoyaki_ouji_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki is wheat batter and kushikatsu is battered and fried.
osaka_takoyaki_ouji_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: takoyaki is made with octopus and dashi.
osaka_takoyaki_ouji_dotonbori.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no seat charge (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 80 seats with counter and sofas; designated smoking area without partition (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Walk-ins usually seated at once even when Dotonbori is packed (February–March 2026), though a queue formed by 1 p.m. on an October 2025 Sunday.
osaka_takoyaki_ouji_dotonbori.notes: [Takoyaki · Dotonbori, a sit-down takoyaki bar up the stairs] A big, casual takoyaki izakaya on the third floor of a building in the middle of Dotonbori, where you can sit down for takoyaki when the street stands are mobbed. Order several kinds: sauce with green onion and mayo, salt or ponzu with green onion (all ¥484 in October 2025), or mentaiko mayo (¥539), plus kushikatsu from shrimp and quail egg to a banana skewer, and dote-yaki. It is cheap for food, less so for drinks (about ¥500 each, February 2026). Opinions run from delicious to average. Often easy to walk into, with a younger and international crowd. Smoking area without partition.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: izakaya, kushiage and okonomiyaki in the middle of Dotonbori, 80 seats, open 11:00–23:00 year-round; a sister shop in Kyoto Kiyamachi (shops.jsonl).

anecdotes.text: "This was my first time trying takoyaki with salt, and it was packed with umami flavor—so delicious!" — October 2025.
"While the Dotonbori bridge (near Glico) was extremely crowded, I was able to enter this place without waiting." — February 2026.
"I jokingly tried a banana skewer, and surprisingly, it was quite good!" — March 2026.

osaka_mankado_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the best-seller is a wheat pastry pie, and mitarashi sauce is soy-sauce based.
osaka_mankado_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The pie is pastry around mochi, mitarashi sauce and red bean paste; ask about butter in the pastry.
osaka_mankado_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). Takeaway shop: there are benches inside but eating in is not allowed (April 2026). Pies are warmed for you (December 2025).
osaka_mankado_shinsaibashi.notes: [Sweets · Shinsaibashi-suji, mitarashi mochi pie to go] A long-established sweets and souvenir counter at the Ebisubashi end of the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, a few steps from the Glico sign, where the thing to buy is the mitarashi mochi pie: flaky pastry around chewy mochi, sweet-soy mitarashi sauce and red bean paste, handed over warm. It cost ¥300 in July 2025 and about ¥350–380 by April 2026. Eat it walking (no eating inside, and it crumbles), or warm it briefly in a microwave or toaster later. The plain mitarashi mochi is good too but keeps only three days. One reviewer found the mitarashi flavour slow to arrive behind the pastry and bean paste. Open daily 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog: Japanese traditional sweets shop on Shinsaibashi-suji, open 10:00–22:00 daily, takeaway. Reviews (2025–2026) call it a long-established confectioner specialising in mitarashi mochi.

anecdotes.text: "The pie is filled with mochi, so it takes a while to get to the Mitarashi flavor." — July 2025, ¥300.
"Inside, there's sweet red bean paste, and the pie itself is crispy and absolutely delicious!" — December 2025; the pie is handed over warm.
"Although there are benches inside the store, eating there is prohibited, so I opted for a walk while enjoying my food." — April 2026.

osaka_yakiniku_zen_namba_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku sauces, sukiyaki warishita and shabu-shabu dips are usually soy-based; one diner chose it to avoid flour-based food (September 2025).
osaka_yakiniku_zen_namba_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–1:00; last order 24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, also on the day (Tabelog; July 2025). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 90 seats, all in private rooms; non-smoking; children welcome, kids menu; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Orders by mobile (September 2025). Opened 1 September 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_zen_namba_shinsaibashi.notes: [Yakiniku · Ebisubashi, all-you-can-eat wagyu in private rooms] An all-you-can-eat black wagyu restaurant on the third floor by Ebisubashi, three minutes from Namba Station, where every table is a private room and you choose yakiniku, shabu-shabu or sukiyaki. Courses start at ¥4,180 (all-you-can-drink from ¥1,650 more), with salad, kimchi and dessert. Reviews are mixed. An October 2026 diner loved the outside skirt and the shabu-shabu and praised the English-speaking manager. Others since 2025 reported missed or wrong orders, no rice refills, and meat some found heavy or average. One March 2026 diner found that a coupon for ¥500 drinks meant ¥500 off. Busy with travellers; open to 1 a.m.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the Shinsaibashi branch of Kuroge Wagyu Zen; A4-or-better black wagyu bought whole; all-you-can-eat yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu from ¥3,800; private table rooms for up to 50; opened 1 September 2023. Two other Namba shops in shops.jsonl (難波千日前, 難波道頓堀).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat black wagyu yakiniku, shabu-shabu and sukiyaki.

osaka_en_chinese_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese sauces usually contain soy sauce; dumplings, noodles and fried dishes are on the menu.
osaka_en_chinese_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Stir-fried bok choy and a soy-meat appetizer appear in reviews; most dishes contain meat or seafood.
osaka_en_chinese_dotonbori.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 15:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Lunch 11:00–14:00 by reservation made the day before (last order 13:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 54 seats at four round tables and a semi-private room for 6; non-smoking; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). English and Chinese menus with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 13 January 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_en_chinese_dotonbori.notes: [Chinese · Dotonbori, Shanghai cooking in a retro basement] A Chinese restaurant down the stairs of a building opposite the Shochikuza theatre, so unlike a typical Chinese place, with its bar-like door and old-Shanghai, Showa-retro room, that first-timers wonder whether this is the right spot. A small team (two chefs from northeast China and a server in July 2025) cooks Shanghai-style dishes adjusted for Japanese tastes; the room was once a French restaurant. The ¥5,000 course centres on Peking duck, with the leftover meat fried as kara-age; the ¥3,500 course is the value pick. À la carte runs to mapo tofu, sweet and sour pork and stir-fried bok choy. Round tables suit groups. Closed Wednesdays; lunch only by booking the day before.

roles: Two chefs from northeast China and a server (July 2025 review); the owner greets guests (November 2025)
chef_bio.origin: Northeast China (the chefs, per a July 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Shanghai cuisine at reasonable prices, over 200 dishes tuned to Japanese tastes, dishes ¥1,000–1,200, set meals and courses at lunch, round tables and private rooms, a modern-jazz room with a hint of Shanghai; opened 13 January 2025. A July 2026 review: the space used to be a French restaurant, taken over by the new owner a year and a half earlier.

anecdotes.text: "Later, I learned that the restaurant is run by a team of three: two chefs from Northeast China and one server." — July 2025.
"After enjoying the Peking duck, I had the meat made into kara-age, which was the best dish for me." — July 2026.
"This restaurant is located underground and doesn't look like a typical Chinese restaurant, which made me a bit nervous as I entered" — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 縁、中華料理、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-5 白亜ビル B1F、なんば駅14番出口から200m・徒歩2分、月火木〜日・祝15:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、水曜定休、ランチは前日までの予約で11:00〜14:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay も) 可、54席 (円卓4つと半個室)、禁煙、持ち込み可、英語・中国語のメニューとスタッフ、2025年1月13日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 本格的な上海料理を手ごろに、200品以上を日本人の好みに合わせて、1品1,000〜1,200円、コース3,500円と北京ダックの5,000円。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年7月): 松竹座の向かいの地下、バーのような入口、上海の租界や昭和レトロのような店内、中国東北部出身の料理人2人と給仕1人、北京ダックの残りの肉を唐揚げに、酢豚、揚州チャーハン、高菜ラーメン、水餃子、酸辣湯、えびマヨ、牛肉とピーマンの炒めもの、麻婆豆腐、青梗菜の炒めもの、なまこ、焼きそば、以前はフランス料理の店だった。

osaka_chugokusai_oil_fukushima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes in sauces; the menu also has shumai, fried rice, yakisoba and batter-fried shrimp.
osaka_chugokusai_oil_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the mapo tofu is made with meat; egg soup at lunch.
osaka_chugokusai_oil_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sundays (Tabelog). No lunch reservations; dinner bookings for up to 8; courses booked by the day before; omakase course from ¥2,800 (Tabelog). One drink per person at dinner; water only on request (Tabelog). Lunch queues of about 20 at opening (October and November 2026). Opened September 3, 2010 (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; October 2026). 17 seats: 7 at the counter and three tables; non-smoking; children welcome, carry babies in, no strollers (Tabelog). Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
osaka_chugokusai_oil_fukushima.notes: [Chinese · Fukushima, the mapo tofu people queue for] A seventeen-seat Sichuan restaurant in Fukushima, open since 2010 and on Tabelog's Chinese WEST 100 list four times, whose name is about oil, the heart of Chinese cooking. The draw is the mapo tofu: a ¥1,700 lunch set with glass-noodle salad, egg soup and free rice, and a queue of about twenty people at the 11:30 opening. Diners describe it as numbing and fragrant rather than fiery; one regular found it oilier and heavier than before, another more refined. Dinner is pricier (mapo and rice ¥2,900, a small beer ¥900) with shumai, shrimp mayo and seasonal specials. Cash only; no lunch bookings; you can buy the house chili oil.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): oil is essential in Chinese cooking, and the name 中国菜オイル expresses the wish that customers will think of the shop as being as important as that oil; opened to let many people eat authentic-tasting Chinese food at low prices, for office workers at lunch and people after work and families at night. Opened September 3, 2010.
chef_bio.philosophy: Affordable, authentic Chinese food for many people (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The mapo tofu was different from the usual heavy flavors; it started with a light aroma, had a slight spiciness, and left a sweet aftertaste" — November 2026.
"It wasn't the sauce that felt heavy, but rather the oil was quite strong, making the dish feel weighty." — October 2026.
"The Sichuan Mapo Tofu a la carte and white rice cost JPY 2900! Lunch comes with a small side dish and soup for JPY 1700" — October 2026.

osaka_steak_teppan_essence.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list includes gluten-free options, with no detail. Sauces include a garlic butter soy sauce and mustard soy sauce (2026 reviews).
osaka_steak_teppan_essence.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and vegetables come from the shop's own farm; nothing vegan is confirmed. Courses centre on wagyu, abalone and lobster.
osaka_steak_teppan_essence.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Same-day bookings welcome; best reached by phone 14:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Opened March 26, 2020 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables in semi-private rooms; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). English menu, with photos (Tabelog). Plates, cakes and bouquets from ¥1,650 (Tabelog).
osaka_steak_teppan_essence.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, a woman owner-chef at the grill] A sixteen-seat teppanyaki room on a Kitashinchi third floor, run by a woman owner-chef who trained at a steakhouse with over fifty years of history and grows organic vegetables on the shop's own farm in Kyotanba. The signature is the live abalone course, abalone grilled whole with a seven-mushroom truffle and porcini sauce, then an A5 Tajima wagyu fillet and garlic rice fried on the teppan; courses run ¥13,200–22,000 plus 10% service. Diners praise the homey room, the flowers on each plate and the chef's warmth, and come for birthdays and business dinners. English menu; weekdays only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic teppanyaki by a female owner-chef, trained at a renowned steakhouse with over 50 years of history; A5 Tajima beef, the roots of Kobe and Matsusaka beef; live abalone and Ise lobster; the owner-chef prepares everything from scratch; organic vegetables grown on the shop's own farm in Kyotanba. Opened March 26, 2020. A September 2026 diner (fourth visit) describes "classic" and "innovative" teppanyaki by "a female chef who loves meat".

osaka_grill_takeya_fukushima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A sauce is used on the yakitori (October 2026), and the menu includes kara-age and grilled rice balls.
osaka_grill_takeya_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken shop; piman, yam and potato dishes appear alongside.
osaka_grill_takeya_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations open around noon on the 20th of each month for the next month, by Instagram direct message, and fill the same day (2025–2026 reviews). No time limit once booked; walk-ins after the first round has left, but the shop may close early when ingredients run out, so call first (August 2026). Some items, such as tamahimo, lamb, gizzard and horumon, must be ordered when booking (2025–2026). Service can be slow; one diner's meal took a little over three hours (October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 seats: 8 at the counter and one table (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_grill_takeya_fukushima.notes: [Yakitori · Fukushima, the monthly booking battle] A ten-seat yakitori shop near the Sky Building, run by a couple and on Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 for 2024, where every seat for the next month goes by Instagram message around noon on the 20th. Diners queue up for skewers half again or twice the usual size, grilled over charcoal by the owner: juicy tsukune, near-rare liver, thick heart and gizzard, plus chicken tataki, piman rice and huge grilled rice balls. About ¥5,000–6,000 a head with drinks. The owner grills alone, so order everything at once and allow time: meals can run three hours. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed) at the grill; the owner's wife serves (2026 reviews)

osaka_hitotoki_togano.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop stresses its sauce as well as ingredients and grilling (Tabelog); horse sashimi is usually eaten with soy sauce; beef-tendon curry at lunch (July 2026).
osaka_hitotoki_togano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and horse meat.
osaka_hitotoki_togano.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–3:30 (last order 2:30); closes at 2:00 if no guests are in, so call ahead to arrive after 2:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner had a ¥1,000 lunch of beef-tendon curry with salad and iced coffee; lunch is not in the Tabelog hours. Appetizer charge ¥330 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay, d Barai (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 10 and two tables for 4; smoking allowed at all seats; private hire up to 20; groups of 6 or more by phone (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog).
osaka_hitotoki_togano.notes: [Yakitori · Umeda, Togano-cho, horse sashimi till 3:30 am] A small, retro charcoal-grill izakaya in Togano-cho with a U-shaped counter, open from 6 pm to 3:30 am every day, pairing Asahibi Jidori yakitori from Hyogo with horse sashimi sent straight from Kumamoto. Order a three-cut basashi platter (one diner had kokorone, futagoe and tenderloin) and a three-kind yakitori plate, plus yagen cartilage and seseri. A ¥330 appetizer is charged, all-you-can-drink courses suit groups, and smoking is allowed at every seat. Diners credit the cheerful woman owner and staff; it is busy, so dishes can be slow. There is a second shop in Doyama.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): charcoal-grilled Asahibi Jidori chicken and horse sashimi sourced directly; ingredients from local producers; a spacious counter for couples, friends and solo diners; all-you-can-drink courses; a smoking-friendly shop. Hyogo chicken; horse sashimi and meat sushi shipped from Kumamoto. A June 2026 diner had earlier visited the Doyama branch and praises "the warm hospitality from the female owner".
